name: ops-troubleshooting
title: Ops Troubleshooting
description: Use to troubleshoot Linux host, network, Kubernetes, and security-hygiene problems with bounded read-only diagnostics that record every command as evidence, then run plan-bound remediation (service restart, rollout restart, managed-pod delete) immediately with the plan's own confirmation. Use soc-event-correlation for attack-story analysis, org-operations for incident reporting, and node-host for node onboarding.
whenToUse: Diagnose why this server is slow or out of disk
Find out why the pod keeps restarting
Check the certificate, DNS, and port reachability for this service
Review recent logins, failed auth attempts, and pending security updates
Plan and, after approval, restart the failing service or rollout

version.description: Report the harness release version, limits, and remediation allowlist.

host.overview.description: Uptime, load, memory, swap, root disk, OS, and top CPU processes with threshold findings.

host.disk.description: Filesystem space and inode usage for local mounts with threshold findings.

host.processes.description: Top processes by CPU or memory, flagging zombies.

host.services.description: Failed systemd units, or the detailed state and restart count of one unit.

host.journal.description: Bounded, redacted journal lines for a window, unit, priority, or pattern.

net.ports.description: Listening TCP/UDP sockets and which are exposed on all interfaces.

net.dns.description: Resolve a name with the host resolver and report timing and nameservers.

net.reach.description: TCP reachability to host:port with optional TLS certificate inspection and expiry findings.

net.route.description: Default routes and interface state from iproute2.

security.logins.description: Recent login sessions from wtmp with per-user and per-source counts.

security.auth-events.description: Failed/accepted SSH logins and sudo use from the journal with brute-force findings.

security.users.description: Interactive accounts, uid 0 accounts, admin group members, authorized_keys counts, and sensitive-file metadata.

security.updates.description: Pending package updates, security updates, and reboot-required state (apt or dnf).

change.recent.description: Recently modified files under an allowlisted root plus recent package operations.

k8s.context.description: Current kubectl context, client/server versions, and read permissions.

k8s.nodes.description: Node readiness, pressure conditions, taints, and optional usage.

k8s.pods.description: Unhealthy pods with restart counts, waiting reasons, OOMKilled history, and scheduling failures.

k8s.describe.description: kubectl describe for an allowlisted read-only kind (never secrets or configmaps).

k8s.logs.description: Bounded pod logs with tail, window, container, previous instance, and pattern filter.

k8s.events.description: Warning (or all) events sorted by recency with reason counts.

k8s.rollout.description: Rollout status, replica counts, conditions, images, and history for a workload.

triage.host.description: One bounded pass over overview, disk, failed units, journal errors, and ports.

triage.k8s.description: One bounded pass over context, nodes, unhealthy pods, and warning events.

remediate.plan.description: Snapshot preconditions and write an approval-bound plan for one allowlisted action.

remediate.apply.description: Apply an approved, unexpired plan once, after re-checking preconditions, and verify the outcome.
